baseline_exclusion.basis: Examples are selected only from rows whose (seed_qid, qid) pair is absent from the KGPrune/PBG-filtered runtime input. Samples are generated afterward and exclude example row IDs and QIDs.

selection_note: Best observed 18-example manual-prompting subset selected from dataset1_path_simple_meta_rebalanced_examples.json. Later adjusted subsets, including a recall-weighted 14 INCLUDE / 4 EXCLUDE variant, underperformed this pack on the Dataset 1 large-sample smoke test. This file is therefore restored to the previous best compact subset before full-dataset submission.

meta_example_pack.selection_note: Replace the manual-derived pack with balanced branch-mode contrasts: direct gateways, narrow productive branches, seed-conditioned mixed parents, broad-parent drift, deeper coherent paths, and hard negative broad-parent subclass cases observed as Gemini failure modes.

selection_constraints: class ratio was not mandatory; this balance is retained because it is the best observed subset
